desc: Identify that the previous bottleneck-distance matching characterization passes samples but is not generally sufficient.
Derive necessary and sufficient conditions for a sequence of global pivot operations, including monotonicity constraints on ordered piece displacements.
Develop an efficient fixed-\(k\) feasibility algorithm for assigning consecutive source groups to target positions.
Prove the minimum-operation formula and validate it on adversarial edge cases, including unchanged endpoints with a moved interior piece.
Implement the corrected algorithm with fast input/output within the total \(N\le 10^6\) constraints.
